verdicts.title: Unramified extensions of quadratic number fields with Galois group $SL_2(7)$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We provide an infinite family of quadratic number fields with everywhere unramified Galois extensions of Galois group $SL_2(7)$. To my knowledge, this is the first instance of infinitely many such realizations for a perfect group which is not generated by involutions, a property which makes it difficult to approach for the problem in question and leads to somewhat delicate local-global problems in inverse Galois theory.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns unramified Galois extensions of quadratic number fields with group SL_2(7), an inverse Galois theory result with no connection to communication complexity matrix rank or counting automorphisms for matrix representations.

verdicts.title: Algebraic theta functions and Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we give an overview of our previous paper concerning the investigation of the algebraic and $p$-adic properties of Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers using Mumford's theory of algebraic theta functions.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns algebraic and p-adic properties of Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers via algebraic theta functions, with no mention of Galois automorphism counts, communication complexity, or matrix rank bounds.
